title: Elon's SpaceX Shares For Every Kid

lines.text: Elon Musk just raised his promise again.
lines.caps: Elon Musk | just raised his promise again.

lines.text: He now says he'll give two SpaceX shares to every child in America, every single year.
lines.caps: He now says he'll give | two SpaceX shares | to every child in America, | every single year.

lines.text: First, he promised one share.
lines.caps: First, | he promised one share.

lines.text: People laughed and called it another random tweet.
lines.caps: People laughed | and called it | another random tweet.

lines.text: Then he doubled it to two.
lines.caps: Then he doubled it | to two.

lines.text: And now, it's two shares every year.
lines.caps: And now, | it's two shares | every year.

lines.text: Do the math.
lines.caps: Do the math.

lines.text: America has about seventy million kids.
lines.caps: America has about | seventy million kids.

lines.text: At around a hundred and thirty dollars a share, that's roughly eighteen billion dollars in a single year.
lines.caps: At around | a hundred and thirty dollars | a share, | that's roughly | eighteen billion dollars | in a single year.

lines.text: Do it every year, and a child born today could own dozens of SpaceX shares by adulthood.
lines.caps: Do it every year, | and a child born today | could own dozens | of SpaceX shares | by adulthood.

lines.text: So why shares and not cash?
lines.caps: So why shares | and not cash?

lines.text: Because a share makes kids curious.
lines.caps: Because a share | makes kids curious.

lines.text: They'll ask: What is SpaceX?
lines.caps: They'll ask: | What is SpaceX?

lines.text: How do rockets work?
lines.caps: How do rockets work?

lines.text: How do we get to Mars?
lines.caps: How do we | get to Mars?

lines.text: That curiosity is how you create the next generation of engineers.
lines.caps: That curiosity | is how you create | the next generation | of engineers.

lines.text: And if Tesla and SpaceX merge, as some reports suggest, each share could include rockets, AI, robots and self-driving cars.
lines.caps: And if Tesla | and SpaceX merge, | as some reports suggest, | each share could include | rockets, AI, | robots | and self-driving cars.

lines.text: Is this genius, a publicity stunt, or a promise that will never happen?
lines.caps: Is this genius, | a publicity stunt, | or a promise | that will never happen?

lines.text: Tell me in the comments.
lines.caps: Tell me | in the comments.

lines.text: And if you want updates related to tech and business, then make sure to follow our page, Things Explained.
lines.caps: And if you want updates | related to tech | and business, | then make sure | to follow our page, | Things Explained.
